title: Translate time to business impact
objective: Classify saved analyst hours, a cancelled tool contract and an estimated increase in win rate.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Saved time is where most value cases start, but it isn't where they should end. Executives fund outcomes, so the case must explain what happens with the time.
Glean's Value Playbook describes four paths from productivity to business impact:

items: **Capacity created → business metric impact.** Freed time is redeployed to more cases, more deals, or higher-value work.
**Cost avoidance.** Tickets deflected, tools consolidated, hires avoided.
**Revenue acceleration.** Faster deal preparation, higher win rates, shorter sales cycles.
**Risk reduction.** Faster incident resolution, better compliance, fewer errors.

blocks.x: For each path, ask what the customer will actually do with the saved time and which system-of-record metric should change. A benefit mechanism needs an owner, not just a multiplier.

items: Saved support effort may let a team handle more cases. If the customer confirms an avoided hire, that becomes hard-dollar cost avoidance, with evidence.
Faster preparation might create selling capacity. Claiming revenue requires much stronger, customer-specific attribution.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Don't label all salary-equivalent time as cash savings, assume layoffs, or claim capacity value and a fully overlapping business benefit for the same minutes. State your exclusions to prevent double counting.

Glean's business-case training uses one test for every translation: who cares? An individual cares about saved minutes. A CFO cares about revenue, cost, and risk. Each path below moves a time estimate into terms a budget holder recognizes, and each needs a named owner who confirms the link.

blocks.title: Four translation paths
blocks.alt: Four cards showing how capacity can translate into business impact: capacity redeployed to a business metric, cost avoided, revenue accelerated, and risk reduced. Each needs an owner who confirms the link.
